sourceAttribution.creator: @personalbrandlaunch
sourceAttribution.analysisScope: Top-20 current-year reel benchmark plus one user-selected style anchor
sourceAttribution.adaptationPolicy: Reproduce production grammar only. Use original Isaiah topics, wording, claims, footage, graphics, colors, and calls to action.

portablePrinciples: Open with simultaneous verbal, visual, and written hooks.
The written hook condenses or reframes the spoken hook; it never transcribes it.
Deliver a useful distinction, framework, rating, or test before asking for action.
Reset the visual approximately every two seconds without cutting away from meaning.
Reuse proven idea structures with new evidence and angles instead of cloning scripts.
Match the call to action to the business goal: follow for audience growth, keyword comment for a relevant asset, or no CTA when trust is the only goal.

researchRules.reusePolicy: Re-angle a validated idea only when the hook, proof, or audience problem changes.

forbidden: generic follow for more before value

editingRules.presenterPriority: Presenter remains the narrative spine; B-roll appears only when it explains the current phrase.
editingRules.bRollPolicy: Prefer short semantic inserts, screen demonstrations, diagrams, comparison labels, and proof captures over decorative stock footage.
editingRules.captionPolicy: One continuous alpha overlay, frame-aligned cues, stable word groups, one highlighted keyword, and no gray lower bar.
editingRules.headlinePolicy: Three to eight words above the face; preserve a separate center-lower caption lane and bottom platform UI reserve.
editingRules.soundPolicy: Dialogue first; music supports emotion at low level; sound effects mark visual events rather than every cut.
